name: Two concurrent clients
description: Rules used by the custom concurrency runner. Each client gets its own session, so each installs these rules into its own isolated rule set.

scenarios.name: slow-client-work
scenarios.description: The work the slow client performs. The runner drives this concurrently with the fast client's PING.

scenarios.name: fast-client-work
scenarios.description: The work the fast client performs, and which must finish while the slow client is still waiting.
